test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only one person is sitting between C and D, considering towards right of D. B is sitting second to the left of D. A is sitting second to the right of C. Who is sitting second to the right of A?
solution:
5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1. Only one person is sitting between C and D, considering towards right of D.

2. B is sitting second to the left of D.

3. A is sitting second to the right of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27f0fe4af716922cbc779c9a98bd3900de5bb6e5256dbf6f524c3574ec1ee4e2.png] 

E sitting second to the right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
